after: Curb military privilege and the old rural restrictions, and commit the court to economic reform.

before: 军府将新营名册与边地战果送到伊犁，要求朝廷承认统治派的功劳。
after: Send the new regimental rolls and reports of frontier victories to Ili, and demand recognition for the military faction's achievements.

before: 工场、铁路与新法已见成效，安国派请求朝廷继续推行其议程。
after: The workshops, railways and new laws are bearing fruit. Petition the court to carry the reforms forward.

before: 工商业的新秩序使生活改善更易赢得人心。
after: The new commercial and industrial order strengthens the loyalty earned by rising living standards.

before: 朝廷的争执拖延日久，生活困顿更易使人心转向激愤。
after: Years of indecision have made falling living standards a greater source of radicalism.
Our people's prosperity must come first.

before: 朝廷终于决定把恢复生产与改造旧法置于军府的要求之前。新任官员将凭借工场、学校和商人的支持施展其主张；军士与武勋门阀则退到了朝议的后列。
after: The court has placed economic recovery and legal reform ahead of the army's demands. New officials will draw their support from workshops, schools and merchants. Soldiers and the military nobility must now yield their former prominence in the imperial councils.
Bring order to the army and the state.

before: 统治派取得了朝廷的信任。军令与征收将更紧密地连在一起，新的官员也更多出自营伍。伊犁的朝议暂时归于一致，代价则由被排除在权力之外的人承担。
after: The military faction has won the confidence of the court. Military command and tax collection will be more closely joined, and more appointments will go to men of the army. Ili has reached an agreement, for now; those excluded from power will bear its cost.
We have squandered too many years.

before: 朝议延续了十年，田地、军饷与官职的争论仍没有结果。地方听过太多振兴帝国的许诺，越来越少的人相信下一道诏令能改变自己的处境。
after: For ten years the court has argued over land, military pay and appointments without reaching a settlement. The provinces have heard promise after promise of imperial renewal. Fewer now believe that another decree will improve their lot.

before: 田野、市镇与营伍仍把自身的前途寄托在帝国之中。
after: Farmers, townspeople and soldiers still see their future in the Empire.

before: 地方正在重新讲述自己的来历，朝廷的号令越来越难抵达。
after: Older local identities are reviving, and imperial authority is weakening in the provinces.

before: 旧日族名已成为结社与举兵的旗帜。
after: Old ethnic names have become rallying cries for armed resistance.

before: 商路、村社与军屯把许多不同来历的人联结在陈秦皇帝的治下。西域汉羌既是帝国扩张的产物，也为这个国家提供了兵员与税源。人们在繁荣中接受共同的身份，也会在征役与贫困中重新寻找旧日的族名、信仰和乡里。
after: Trade routes, village communities and military colonies bind peoples of many origins to the Chen emperors of Qin. The Western Regions Han-Qiang emerged from imperial expansion and now provide much of the Empire's manpower and revenue. Prosperity encourages a common identity. Conscription and hardship can lead people back to older loyalties of kinship, faith and homeland.

before: 边地的社团已不再满足于请愿。他们募集粮饷，联系旧贵族与宗教领袖，以本地人的名义向帝国征税的官署和征兵的军府发出挑战。伊犁仍有机会恢复人心，但拖延将使各地的反抗连成一片。
after: Petitions no longer satisfy the associations of the frontier. They are gathering provisions, approaching old noble families and religious leaders, and challenging imperial tax collectors and recruiting officers in the name of local peoples. Ili may yet recover their allegiance. Delay will allow scattered resistance to grow into a common revolt.

before: 地方已不再相信旧日的许诺。
after: The provinces have lost faith in our promises.

before: [SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_qe1_declining_region').GetName]的村社与军屯正在重述自己的来历。旧时的族名、经文与乡里关系重新成为人们彼此信任的凭据。当地约半数西域汉羌如今重新以[SCOPE.sCulture('nesnd_qe1_return_culture').GetName]自称，信奉[SCOPE.sReligion('nesnd_qe1_return_religion').GetName]。
after: The villages and military colonies of [SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_qe1_declining_region').GetName] are rediscovering their past. Old ethnic names, sacred texts and local ties are once again the foundations of trust. About half of the province's Western Regions Han-Qiang now identify as [SCOPE.sCulture('nesnd_qe1_return_culture').GetName] and follow the [SCOPE.sReligion('nesnd_qe1_return_religion').GetName] faith.

before: 皇族、地方士人与军府正在争夺帝国的中枢。
after: The imperial house, provincial literati and army are competing for control of the government.

before: 皇帝凭借旧日征服的威望任命官员，地方士人依靠学堂、商号和官署主持日常政务，军队则掌握了帝国赖以扩张的武力。三者的合作使朝廷得以运转，他们也都希望把其他两方变成自己的助力。
after: The Emperor appoints officials by the authority of past conquests. Provincial scholars conduct the business of government through schools, trading houses and public offices. The army commands the force on which the Empire's expansion depends. All three sustain the court, and each hopes to bend the others to its purposes.

before: 让依靠皇室任命的军士与官员掌握更多职位。
after: Grant more offices to soldiers and administrators whose position depends on imperial appointment.

before: 让学堂、商号与文官的意见更多地进入朝廷。
after: Give schools, trading houses and civil officials a greater voice at court.

before: 让军队及支持军府的市民取得更多的政治声望。
after: Raise the political standing of the army and its supporters in the towns.

before: 朝廷停止对这一方的特别扶持。
after: End the court's special support for this faction.

before: 以军队与职业团体重组国家，专制的权力将由法团机关行使。
after: Reorganize the state around the army and occupational corporations, placing autocratic authority in corporate institutions.

before: 废除皇位，由民选总统与实行比例代表的议会主持国政。
after: Abolish the throne and establish an elected president and a parliament chosen by proportional representation.

before: 保留皇位，把官署交给受过专业训练的技术官僚，以此重建君主的统治。
after: Preserve the throne and entrust the administration to trained technocrats, restoring the monarch's control of government.

before: Literate property-owning voters elect representatives; political groups form a parliament and government according to their support.
after: Literate voters with sufficient property elect representatives. Political groups take their seats in parliament and form governments according to their share of support.

before: 河西的关隘与关中的田地仍在陈秦皇族的记忆之中。若帝国能够重新控制通往东方的道路，恢复军队与官署的力量，朝廷便有机会以故土为起点，再次争夺华夏的天下。
after: The Chen imperial house has not forgotten the passes of Hexi or the fields of Guanzhong. By recovering the roads to the east and rebuilding its army and administration, the Empire could make these ancestral lands the foundation of a renewed struggle for China.
Rebuild our armies on the ancestral lands.
Carry the reforms into the provinces first.

before: 秦军重新控制了河西与关中的道路。故土的归属已经改变，朝廷却仍须决定如何使用这次胜利：以新军继续向东，还是先把新的官署、产业与共同身份扎根于各省。
after: Qin forces once again control the roads through Hexi and Guanzhong. The court must decide how to use its victory: prepare fresh armies for the march east, or first establish new institutions, industries and a common identity throughout the recovered provinces.

before: 向朝廷效忠的军队，听候调遣。
after: Let all troops loyal to the court stand ready.

before: 帝国只剩下最后的疆土。
after: Only the last of our lands remain.

before: 被排除在朝议之外的官员与军人已经集结成军。他们自称讨逆，宣告伊犁已被一派私党控制，要求以武力重新决定帝国的政务。朝廷内部的争执终于走出了官署。
after: Officials and officers excluded from the imperial councils have gathered an army. Calling themselves loyalists, they denounce the faction that holds Ili and demand a new settlement by force. The struggle at court has become an armed rebellion.

before: 地方官署已经改换旗帜。布哈拉、花剌子模与草原的旧名重新进入军令和税册，各地不再承认伊犁对人丁、土地与征赋的支配。朝廷保住的疆土之外，昔日帝国正在变成彼此争夺的新国家。
after: Provincial governments have raised new flags. The old names of Bukhara, Khwarezm and the steppe appear once more in military orders and tax rolls. Local rulers no longer acknowledge Ili's authority over their people, land or revenue. Beyond the few provinces still held by the court, the Empire is giving way to rival states.

before: 朝廷尚未决定与伊犁的关系。
after: The court has yet to settle its relations with Ili.

before: 使者正在往来，朝廷准备借秦国的力量经营西方。
after: Envoys are seeking Qin support for expansion in the west.

before: 朝廷的使者正在中亚联络不满伊犁的地方势力。
after: Our envoys are approaching Central Asian leaders opposed to Ili.
The Future of the Near-Western Empire

before: 唐衣大食的君臣熟悉秦国的军府，也熟悉波斯的商旅与地方家族。近西战争留下了土地和声望，却没有替后人决定帝国的方向：朝廷可以借伊犁的力量向西经营，也可以在西秦的地方纷争中寻找独立扩张的机会。
after: The Tang-Persian court knows both the military government of Qin and the merchants and great families of Persia. The Near-Western War brought land and prestige, but left the Empire's future course unsettled. The court may seek Ili's help for expansion to the west, or exploit unrest in Western Qin to pursue conquests of its own.

before: 军府带来的官制与本地的书院、宗教学校和家族并存。朝廷要使不同出身的官员共同办事，就需要可靠的任官制度，也需要能够训练新人的学堂。
after: The offices introduced by the military government stand alongside local academies, religious schools and family networks. To make officials of these different backgrounds work together, the court needs reliable appointments and schools capable of training their successors.

before: 棉田、织工与往来商旅维持着波斯的繁荣。朝廷希望用铁路联结产地与市镇，使近西战争得到的土地不仅供养军队，也能养活新的工场。
after: Cotton fields, weavers and travelling merchants sustain Persia's prosperity. By linking the countryside to its towns with railways, the court hopes to make the lands won in the Near-Western War support new workshops as well as the army.

before: 朝廷已把目光投向两河以西。来自秦国的军事传统与波斯的财力将服务于新的扩张，而奥斯曼、埃及及阿拉伯的诸国也会寻找自己的强国援手。
after: The court has turned its attention beyond Mesopotamia. Qin military traditions and Persian wealth will sustain a new campaign of expansion. The Ottomans, Egypt and the states of Arabia may seek powerful allies of their own.

before: 伊犁的权威正在受到挑战。朝廷准备沿中亚与印度的道路追求自己的利益，昔日宗主的边疆如今也进入了军府的地图。
after: Ili's authority is under challenge. The court intends to pursue its own interests along the routes through Central Asia and India. The frontiers of its former overlord now attract the attention of Persian commanders.

before: 请求秦国帮助朝廷整顿官署与军政，为向西扩张准备力量。
after: Request Qin assistance in reforming our administration and army, in preparation for expansion to the west.
Approach the Peoples of Western Qin

before: 结交不满伊犁的地方领袖，准备摆脱宗主并经营东方。
after: Cultivate local leaders opposed to Ili and prepare to cast off our overlord's rule and expand eastward.

before: 任用受过训练的官员，把书院与官署的培养连在一起。
after: Appoint trained officials and bring the academies into closer cooperation with the administration.

before: 支持已有的棉田、织造与铁路，使商路和工场相互接续。
after: Support our cotton fields, textile mills and railways, joining trade routes to industrial production.

after: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.

after: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.

after: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.
Assert Our Claims in the Indus Valley

before: 朝廷将向尚未承认我方权利的地区发出照会；相关强国可能出面阻挠。
after: Present our territorial claims by diplomatic note. Powers with interests in the region may oppose them.

before: 秦国派来的官员带来了军府之外的另一种经验。他们与本地书吏共同整理法令，希望使官员、商人和田主不必再为同一件事奔走于几套不同的规矩之间。
after: The officials sent by Qin bring experience beyond military administration. Working with local clerks, they are putting the laws in order so that officials, merchants and landowners need no longer contend with several conflicting sets of rules for the same business.

before: 随使团而来的工匠已经进入当地工场。他们传授测量、营造与机器维修的方法，也需要本地工人与商人把这些知识变成能够长期经营的产业。
after: The craftsmen who accompanied the mission have arrived in our workshops. They are teaching surveying, construction and machine maintenance. Local workers and merchants must now turn those skills into lasting enterprises.

before: 秦国使者在朝会上确认了对本朝的支持。与伊犁保持联系的军官和商人因此安下心来，朝廷也得以暂时压低反对者的声势。
after: The Qin envoy has affirmed his court's support for our government. Officers and merchants with ties to Ili are reassured, and the endorsement has quieted the court's opponents for the time being.

before: 朝廷已经完成面向西方的部署。伊犁能否继续提供援助，仍取决于两国眼下的处境；波斯的军府与商人则已开始议论新的道路和土地。
after: Preparations for expansion to the west are complete. Further aid from Ili will depend on the circumstances of both states. Persian commanders and merchants are already discussing new routes and new lands.

before: 近西战争将有新的篇章。
after: The Near-Western War enters a new chapter.

before: 联络西秦地方势力的部署已经完成。朝廷准备以自身的名义经营中亚与印度，来自伊犁的号令将不再决定这条道路。
after: Our preparations among the local powers of Western Qin are complete. The court will pursue its own ambitions in Central Asia and India, free of orders from Ili.
Deliver the note to the foreign courts.

before: 朝廷已正式申明对[SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_per_claim_region').GetName]的权利。军府与商人可以据此准备下一步行动，土地的实际归属仍有待外交与战争决定。
after: The court has formally asserted its claim to [SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_per_claim_region').GetName]. Commanders and merchants can prepare their next moves. Possession of the territory must still be secured through diplomacy or war.

before: 关于[SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_per_claim_region').GetName]的照会遭到强国阻挠。朝廷暂未取得所求的承认，必须先改变当地的外交处境。
after: A foreign power has opposed our claim to [SCOPE.sStateRegion('nesnd_per_claim_region').GetName]. The court has failed to secure recognition. It must improve its diplomatic position before renewing the demand.
